Homepagecarddetails1:
Chaithanya Kala Bharathi, is a non-governmental organization started in the year 1992 by a group of social Activists, well experienced social workers who are local people and are very familiar  with grim socio-economic realities of the area.  The organization aims  to render best social services for tribal communities, dalits and other vulnerable communities like women, children and disabled in their  area of operation.  
 It is led under the resourceful leadership of Prof. R. Ratna Swamy and Mr. V.V.Bhaskar. Both of them have social outlook, buoyant social spirit to serve tribes, dalits, women, children and other vulnerable sections of the community. They are well identified in the operational area for their 20 long years standing social services through CKB
Homepagecarddetails2: The organization is working in Kurnool and Nandyal Districts (erstwhile Kurnool District).
Homepagecarddetails3:
The Federation is focusing on five key areas:  
  1.Catalyzing the formation of multi-purpose cooperatives 
 2.Capacity building of the marginalized farmers to manage the cooperatives.
 3.Arranging finances, especially for process and for value adding investments 
 4.Providing technical support where required in agriculture, NTFP and food processing 
 5.Extending a market intelligence system for the cooperatives.
